verse.text: For husbands, this means love your wives, just as Christ loved the church. He gave up his life for her

video.title: Choose to Love | Ephesians 5:25 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Loving like Christ isn't about grand gestures — it's showing up on the hard days, putting your wife's needs ahead of your own comfort, and letting her see that your love doesn't quit when things get inconvenient. Your kids are watching how you treat their mom, and that example will shape what they expect from love and marriage far more than any lecture you give them. Start small today: one sacrifice, one act of patience, done quietly and without keeping score.
